class Node:
    def __init__(self, v, l=None, r=None):
        self.v, self.l, self.r = v, l, r

def inorder(root):
    out, stack, cur = [], [], root
    while cur or stack:
        while cur:
            stack.append(cur)
            cur = cur.l
        cur = stack.pop()
        out.append(cur.v)
